chunks: From Suma'ah, he said: I heard him saying:
Allah (Glorified is His Majesty) has made His friends the target of His enemies in this world.
ai.seo_question: Why are the friends of Allah targeted by their enemies in this world?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the theological reality of divine friendship (wilayah), stating that being a friend of Allah entails being a target for His enemies in this worldly life. It highlights that affliction and opposition are inherent signs of one's closeness to God.

en.muhajir-b-ali: 17. It has been narrated that Suma'ah said: I heard him (al-Sadiq (a.s)) saying:
Allah has allowed His friends to be the target of His enemies in this world.
